tagline: One Apollo. One Firm. One Team.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net IRR is the key KPI because it measures the actual performance delivered to investors after fees, which is the primary driver of fundraising and reputation in asset management.

kpis.explanation_en: Annualized net return to investors in Apollo funds after fees.
kpis.signal: Strong performance on ADIP I (2020) fund at 18%, up versus prior periods.
kpis.description: Net IRR is the primary performance metric for private equity funds. It reflects Apollo's ability to generate value for its LPs.

kpis.explanation_en: Annualized return before deduction of fees and costs.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in Gross IRR on ADIP I (2020) to 21%, indicating strong value creation.
kpis.description: Gross IRR shows the gross performance of investments, independent of fees.

kpis.explanation_en: Total value of assets managed by Apollo on behalf of its clients.
kpis.signal: Steady AUM growth, reflecting investor confidence.
kpis.description: AUM is a key indicator of the size and growth trajectory of the firm.

kpis.explanation_en: Value of assets sold or exited from portfolios.
kpis.signal: Increase in value realization, signaling successful asset exits.
kpis.description: Realized value indicates Apollo's ability to monetize its investments.

kpis.explanation_en: Current value of assets still held in portfolios.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in unrealized value, reflecting stable valuations.
kpis.description: Unrealized value shows the future exit potential of portfolio assets.

kpis.explanation_en: Total amount deployed into investments by Apollo funds.
kpis.signal: Ongoing capital deployment, indicating sustained investment activity.
kpis.description: Invested capital reflects the firm's investment deployment activity.

kpis.signal: Total revenue of $32.049 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.explanation_en: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.signal: Net income of $3.492 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last four reported fiscal years (10-K).

ai_positioning.summary: The company APO does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
